senses.gloss: (b. h.; preced.; cmp. meanings of סוּר)to remove (the inhabitants of), make desolate.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (ref. to <he>עוים</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 2:23">Deut. II, 23</cite>, v.
<cite ref="Ezekiel 21:32">Ez. XXI, 32</cite>) <he>שצָדוּ את העולם</he> they depopulated the world.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:1">Cant. R. to IV, 1</cite> they offer seventy sacrifices on the Succoth festival in behalf of the nations <he>שלא יִצָּדֶה העולם מהן</he> that the world may not be depopulated of them (through their extinction); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782:27">Yalk. Num. 782</cite>; Pesik. Bayom, p. 194ᵃ <he>יצאו</he> (Ms. O. <cite ref="J00551"><he>יצרא</he></cite>; corr. acc.). Gen. R. l. c. <he>גרמו לעולם שיִצּוֹד</he> (from <he>צדד</he> or <cite ref="R00161"><he>צוד</he></cite>) they were the cause that the world was desolated (through the flood).

senses.gloss: to be removed. Ib. הוּצְדּוּ מן העולם they were removed from the world.
